title: The Pony
description: Framed mixed-media collage mounted against a crumpled silver-foil background. Two orange plastic set-squares flank a central cardboard panel inscribed 'THE "PONY"' with the name 'SEBASTIAN' written vertically; gold-leaf fragments, iridescent elements, and layered paper scraps fill the composition.
composition: framed collage flanked by orange triangles
